articles.title: Green Party leader Zack Polanski to stand in by-election for Starmer’s seat
articles.snippet: The leader of the United Kingdom’s Green Party intends to stand in an election for a seat in parliament vacated by former Labour Prime Minister Keir Starmer, local media reported.
